parameters.name: ConditionalAccessPolicyType
parameters.description:
条件访问策略类型，取值可选范围：

arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:policy:system：系统策略。

parameters.name: ConditionsConfig
parameters.description: 条件访问策略条件内容配置

parameters.name: DecisionType
parameters.description:
条件访问策略执行类型，取值可选范围：

enforcement：执行策略。

parameters.name: EvaluateAt
parameters.description:
条件访问策略执行点, 取值可选范围：

- arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:rule:eval_at:after_step1：允许。

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
条件访问策略-优先级, 数值越低优先级越高
最小值：1
最大值：100

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-conditional-access-policy --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --conditional-access-policy-name My_conditional_access_policy --description Test_description --conditional-access-policy-type arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:policy:system --decision-type enforcement --evaluate-at arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:rule:eval_at:after_step1 --decision-config '{"MfaAuthenticationMethods":["ia_totp"],"MfaAuthenticationIntervalSeconds":500,"ActiveSessionReuseStatus":"enabled","Effect":"allow_or_deny","MfaType":"directly_access"}' --conditions-config '{"NetworkZones":{"IncludeNetworkZones":["network_xxxxx"],"ExcludeNetworkZones":["network_xxxxx"]},"Applications":{"ExcludeApplications":["app_xxxx"],"IncludeApplications":["app_xxxx"]},"Users":{"ExcludeOrganizationalUnits":["ou_xxxxx"],"IncludeUsers":["user_xxxx"],"ExcludeGroups":["group_xxxxx"],"ExcludeUsers":["user_xxxx"],"IncludeOrganizationalUnits":["ou_sdfnbsxxxx"],"IncludeGroups":["group_xxxxx"]}}' --priority 1 --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateConditionalAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Description Test_description --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeOrganizationalUnits.1 ou_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeUsers.1 user_xxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeGroups.1 group_xxxxx --DecisionConfig.MfaAuthenticationIntervalSeconds 500 --Priority 1 --DecisionConfig.ActiveSessionReuseStatus enabled --ConditionalAccessPolicyType 'arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:policy:system' --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeUsers.1 user_xxxx --DecisionType enforcement --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeGroups.1 group_xxxxx --EvaluateAt 'arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:rule:eval_at:after_step1' --ConditionsConfig.Applications.ExcludeApplications.1 app_xxxx --DecisionConfig.Effect allow_or_deny --ConditionsConfig.NetworkZones.IncludeNetworkZones.1 network_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.NetworkZones.ExcludeNetworkZones.1 network_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeOrganizationalUnits.1 ou_sdfnbsxxxx --ConditionalAccessPolicyName My_conditional_access_policy --ConditionsConfig.Applications.IncludeApplications.1 app_xxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --DecisionConfig.MfaAuthenticationMethods.1 ia_totp --DecisionConfig.MfaType directly_access --method POST --force
